issue.title: capture_pomodoros warning test flakes under parallel cargo test
issue.description:
## Flake report

The test `native::capture_pomodoros::tests::missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes` in `src/native/capture_pomodoros.rs` intermittently returned a count of 1 where the assertion expected 0 during the full parallel Rust unit suite. The same test passed unchanged when run alone; investigate shared environment or other parallel-test interference and make the test deterministic.

task_type_fields.evidence: Observed 1 failure in 1 full parallel just all run (1,616 passed, 1 failed), then 1 pass in 1 unchanged isolated cargo test run. It did not reproduce serially; the full-suite fail rate is 1/1 observed and serial fail rate 0/1.

issue.creation_reason: The full `just all` run failed this test once, while the unchanged test passed on an isolated rerun. This intermittent failure makes the full Rust test result unreliable until the test isolation issue is understood.

payload.entry: Further evidence: Two additional unchanged full parallel suite runs also failed this test; total observed parallel result is 3 failures in 3 full runs, while the focused serial rerun passed 1 of 1. The full suite passed with RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 and NO_COLOR unset. The cause of the parallel interference remains unconfirmed.
